notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.5.1 released, Audio Update II and OST!
notes.notes:
This release features even more ambiances and music, further enriching your adventures in the world of NetHack! See the changelog below for the full list of changes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds new music tracks to Gnomish Mines and Sokoban
[*] Adds new music tracks and ambiances to endgame levels
[*] Changes title screen
[*] Fixes issue with audio sometimes dropping on screen resize
[/list]

[h1]NetHack: Legacy OST[/h1]
The official soundtrack is now available for your listening pleasure! Explore the Dungeons of Doom without the threat of starvation or vengeful Ants looming over your head! With over an hour of beautifully composed music, you can revisit your favorite areas and tracks, or take a peek into environments you have yet to discover! The full album also includes bonus, loopable ambiance tracks for setting the mood at your next tabletop game session!

[url= https://andreabaroni.bandcamp.com/album/nethack-legacy-original-soundtrack]NetHack: Legacy OST on Bandcamp[/url]

notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.4.2 released, Audio Update!
notes.notes:
This release features more ambiances, music, and special effects to further immerse you into the world of NetHack! See the changelog below for the full list of changes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds new ambiances and tracks
[*] Adds sound effects
[*] Adds text search option to replay viewer
[*] Changes "mouse_support" option to allow disabling
[*] Changes replay viewer to play soundtrack
[*] Fixes occasional "PID mismatch" issue
[*] Fixes issue with "unknown details" on some leaderboard entries
[*] Fixes issue with leaderboard replays sometimes disappearing
[*] Fixes issue with replays sometimes being corrupted
[*] Fixes issue with replays sometimes not displaying correctly on jumps
[*] Fixes issues with audio sometimes glitching/not playing in correct areas
[/list]
